title: Stapler
prompt: A chunky red office stapler, closed, toy-like rounded shapes, simple clean colours, single object
motion: Keep the base fixed on the table. Add a hinge at the back so the top arm swings open about 40 degrees and then snaps shut quickly, repeating.

title: Desk fan
prompt: A small retro desk fan with a round wire cage, light blue body and white blades, cartoon toy style, single object
motion: Keep the base and the stand fixed. The fan blades and their hub rotate continuously around the central axle.
